Welcome to Sky Map

To get you stargazing, please review this quick summary of our terms.

Privacy

We don\'t know who you are. We collect anonymous usage data to help us fix bugs and improve features. You can opt out of this at any time in the Settings menu.

Safety & Liability

Sky Map is provided \"as is.\" Use it safely—we aren\'t responsible for any damages or injuries (like neck ache!) resulting from your use of the app.

Open Source

Sky Map is a labor of love. You are free to use our source code, but please respect our branding and logos.

Read the full legal document here: Full Terms and Privacy Policy

string.name: permissions_notice
string.translation_description: Legally-required disclosure of the device permissions the app requests, why it requests them, and the user\'s right to refuse the optional ones. Shown on the first-launch terms screen and in Help. Please do not change the markup

resources.string:
Permissions

Sky Map has no required permissions. Every permission below is optional — you may refuse any of them and still use the app. Sky Map never asks at startup: each permission is requested only when you first use the feature that needs it, and you can grant or withdraw each one separately at any time under Settings → Apps → Sky Map → Permissions on your device.

Location — optional

What is accessed: your approximate location.

Why: which stars are above you depends on where you are, so Sky Map uses your approximate location to draw the correct sky.

If you refuse: you can type in a place name or coordinates instead, and the whole app keeps working.

Your location is used on your device to draw the sky. It is never sent to us.

Camera — optional

What is accessed: the camera preview.

Why: through-camera mode draws the sky on top of the live camera view, so you can match the map against what you are really looking at.

If you refuse: every other mode works as normal.

Sky Map never records the camera view or sends it to us. It is drawn on screen and then discarded — unless you share a picture: choosing an AR layout from the share sheet saves that one image on your device and hands it to the app you pick. Nothing is shared until you ask for it.

Notifications — optional

What is accessed: permission to show notifications.

Why: to let you know about meteor-shower peaks and what is worth seeing tonight, if you ask for those.

If you refuse: nothing else changes — these notifications stay off until you turn them on.
